name: tokio-prompt-orchestrator (LLM API proxy)
description: Installs orchestrator, an HTTP proxy that puts a queue, deduplication and a circuit breaker in front of any LLM API, so repeated prompts cost one call and outages fail fast.

version.description: Release to install, e.g. 1.2.2. 'latest' follows the newest GitHub release of Mattbusel/tokio-prompt-orchestrator.
